groups.title: --- telemetry and analytics: the TV reporting on you -------------------------

packages.note: "DAC" analytics uploader: channel watched, resolution, HDMI-CEC devices, viewing times, Ambilight config. Uploads to AWS Firehose/S3 and geolocates the public IP via ipinfo.io
metrics collector running inside candeebug's process
boot stats, remote keypress counts, panel/eMMC telemetry feeding the two above

groups.title: --- promoted content, storefronts and retail junk ----------------------------

packages.note: its headless backend; disable the row above first or you get a live tile with no data source
"NetTvApps", headless; holds TV_INSTALL_PACKAGES_SILENT, i.e. the gallery's silent preload installer
"Demo me" retail demo mode, e-sticker and shop loop
HD+ (German satellite operator) info pages; not applicable on a UK Freeview set
Play auto-install of TP Vision partner apps
"Android TV Core Services" despite the name: recommendation rows, channels AND the notification panel. Disabling this is visible: the stock notification panel goes with it
runs once at first setup, nothing afterwards
Second Screen Setup Auth Bridge (set-up-from-phone helper)
Google Calendar sync; no calendar app is installed on this TV
Play Games; not used on a TV

groups.title: --- owner's explicit choices on this unit -----------------------------------

packages.note: Assistant and voice search, ~101 MB across two processes. Kills the remote's mic button, "Hey Google", on-screen voice search and the mic icon inside YouTube/Play Store search. Settings and tvsystemui guard their calls into it, so nothing crashes

LAN control of volume, audio output, Ambilight on/off and ShopMode. NOT the JointSpace API on 1925/1926 -- that is served by org.droidtv.xtv, which stays. Owner does not drive the TV from Home Assistant
